data.name: Akeel
data.gender_notes: Akeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Akeel is a noble Arabic name meaning 'wise', 'intelligent', or 'discerning'. It is commonly used in Islamic cultures to signify a person of intellect and good judgment. The name Akeel carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Akeel usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents someone blessed with deep understanding, clear thinking, and thoughtful behavior — a mind guided by wisdom.
data.etymology: Akeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akeel total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عقيل
in_arabic.meaning: عقيل يعني الحكيم و العاقل و صاحب الرأي الصائب
in_arabic.long_meaning: عقيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الحكيم و العاقل و صاحب الرأي الصائب. و يأتي من الجذر اللغوي 'ع-ق-ل' الذي يعني الفهم و الإدراك. و قد ورد ذكر اسم عقيل في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران آية 144، قال تعالى: 'وما قتلتهُمْ إلا بالحق وما قتلهم إلا هو الذي قتلهم ومن قتل منهم منهم من قتل و من قتل منهم قتل بالتوراة'

in_urdu.name: عقیل
in_urdu.meaning: عقیل مطلب ہے عقلمند، حكيم، اور سچے مشورے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عقیل ایک علم مذكر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے عقلمند، حكيم، اور سچے مشورے والا۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع-ق-ل' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سمجھنا اور ادراک کرنا۔ عقیل نام تاریخی اور ثقافتی لحاظ سے اہم ہے اور اسلامی روایات میں بھی اس کا ذکر ملتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अक़ील
in_hindi.meaning: अक़ील का अर्थ है बुद्धिमान, समझदार और सही सलाह देने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक़ील एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमान, समझदार और सही सलाह देने वाला। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'ع-ق-ل' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है समझना और बोध करना। अक़ील नाम इस्लामी परंपराओं में महत्वपूर्ण है और इसका उल्लेख ऐतिहासिक और सांस्कृतिक संदर्भों में मिलता है

in_pashto.name: عقیل
in_pashto.meaning: عقیل د معنا داړه، حکیم، او د سمې مشورې ورکوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عقیل یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې نه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د 'ع-ق-ل' جذر نه مشتق شوی دی چی د پوهیدو او ادراک معنی ورکوي. عقیل نوم په اسلامی دودیزو کې مهم دی او تاریخی او کلتوری پلوه بډایه شوی دی

in_english.name: Akeel
in_english.meaning: Akeel means wise, intelligent, and sound advisor
in_english.long_meaning: Akeel is a masculine given name derived from Arabic. It originates from the root 'ع-ق-ل' (a-q-l) which means to understand or perceive. The name Akeel signifies wisdom, intelligence, and sound judgment. It holds historical significance in Islamic tradition and is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al Imran verse 144. Akeel is associated with positive personality traits such as being wise, knowledgeable, and possessing good counsel. The name is used across various Muslim cultures and communities worldwide

data.cultural_impact: The name Akeel is often associated with the wisdom and leadership qualities of Prophet Amin and Prophet Ali (peace be upon them), who were known for their intelligence and wise decision-making abilities. This name has a rich cultural significance in Islamic society as it reflects the importance of intellectual and moral excellence.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Akeel represents the inner wisdom and discernment that come from a deep connection with God. It is a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding, and using that knowledge wisely to help others and contribute positively to society. It is also a reminder of the need to rely on God's guidance and wisdom in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Akeel means "Sole Trustee" or "Dependable One" in Arabic. It symbolizes one's unwavering faith and trust in Allah (God) and being relied upon by others due to one's trustworthiness and reliability.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Akeel ibn Umar was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Akeel carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Akeel was a prominent Sahabi (companion) of the Prophet Muhammad and was known for his bravery and loyalty.
